agyos_skill.intent: Find bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues in local branch changes. Use when asked to review changes, find bugs, security review, or audit code on the current branch.
agyos_skill.instructions: Review changes on this branch for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues. - You need a review focused on bugs, security issues, or risky code changes. - The task involves auditing the current branch diff rather than implementing new behavior. - You want a structured review process with checklist-driven verification against changed files. 1. Get the FULL diff: `git diff $(gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef --jq '.defaultBranchRef.name')...HEAD` 2. If output is truncated, read each changed file individually until you have seen every changed line 3. List all files modified in this branch before proceeding For each changed file, identify and list: * All user inputs (request params, headers, body, URL components) * All database queries * All authentication/authorization checks * All session/state operations * All external calls * All cryptographic operations * [ ] **Injection**: SQL, command, template, header injection * [ ] **XSS**: All outputs in templates properly escaped? * [ ] **Authentication**: Auth checks on all protected operations? * [ ] **Authorization/IDOR**: Access control verified, not just auth? * [ ] **CSRF**: State-changing operations protected? * [ ] **Race conditions**: TOCTOU in any read-then-write patterns? * [ ] **Session**: Fixation, expiration, secure flags? * [ ] **Cryptography**: Secure random, proper algorithms, no secrets in logs? * [ ] **Information disclosure**: Error messages, logs, timing attacks? * [ ] **DoS**: Unbounded operations, missing rate limits, resource exhaustion? * [ ] **Business logic**: Edge cases, state machine violations, numeric overflow?
